overall: The look is mostly coherent neon; the main faults are a few flat pale bars, portal clusters with no visible purpose, and crowded or overlapping deco at the ceiling and the end signature.

notes.note: the pale green bars in the air have no faces or side shading and read as flat, unfinished lines.
three rings stacked in a tight run (cyan, green, cyan) with no clear purpose between them.
a dense row of ceiling saws and spike triangles crowds the top of the path.
a faint green outlined box sits behind the ship and reads as a stray fragment.
the spike row ends against a small purple corner stub with white outlines that looks like a broken joint.
the dark sawtooth ground blends into the brown background, so its edges are hard to read.
the signature text is partly covered by an orange ring and the robot deco.
a yellow ring sits between two cyan rings in a tight cluster, adding nothing visible.
